covered_report_window: After the U.S. market close on Thursday, November 12, 2026 through before the U.S. market open on Friday, November 13, 2026
market_context_summary: At 12:46 p.m. ET the S&P 500 and Nasdaq were each about 0.2% higher after sharp early losses; Nvidia remained volatile, the 10-year Treasury yield was near 5.10%, and U.S. PPI is due at 8:30 a.m. ET Friday.

methodology.disparity_definition: Average of the three pairwise absolute direction-score gaps normalized by 2 and the three pairwise reversal-risk gaps; 0 is perfect agreement and 100 is maximum normalized disagreement.
methodology.lessons_review: No new method change; standing timing, decisive-KPI, priced-in growth and low-bar reversal-risk rules applied.
universe_exclusions: GFF removed for all passes because official IR confirmed November 17, overriding stale November 12 calendar data.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Record operating momentum and a sharp pre-event de-risking favor upside if FY27 guidance validates AI, DRAM, logic and advanced-packaging demand.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is about $4.06 EPS and $10.30B revenue; the real test is Q1/FY27 guidance and gross margin.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: FY27 demand visibility and margin resilience clear the elevated bar.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: China restrictions, component shortages or soft forward guidance overwhelm a beat.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Public benchmarks suggest roughly a mid-single-digit event range; shares sold off sharply with the AI complex.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Street remains constructive, but supply constraints and export exposure are active concerns.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: The pre-release established strong scale, leaving organic margin, cash conversion and integration quality as the route to incremental upside.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Preliminary sales were about $4.90B and adjusted EBITDA $557M; headline surprise is largely known.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Management shows clean organic margin and cash conversion across acquired assets.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Acquisition accounting, leverage or weak organic trends dilute the pre-release.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: The pre-release already moved expectations, increasing sell-the-news risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Consensus revenue had already converged near $4.9B; full-detail quality matters more than EPS.

ranked_companies.expected_driver: AISC / cash conversion on record silver
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Record Q3 silver output and strong realized metal prices support upside if costs and cash conversion validate the production headline.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is roughly $0.02 EPS and $63M revenue; production was pre-disclosed at a record 800,458 silver ounces.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: AISC and free cash flow convert record output and strong realized prices into earnings.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Cost inflation, weak recoveries or heavy growth spending absorb the metal-price benefit.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Smaller mining float and commodity beta can amplify either direction; reliable event-implied move was unavailable.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Sparse coverage; pre-announced production is the clearest evidence point.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Exceptional TPV growth supports upside only if gross profit and operating leverage prove that volume growth is not being bought through mix dilution.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is near $0.21 EPS; Q2 TPV rose 92% but gross profit over TPV compressed to 0.72%.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: TPV growth converts into gross profit and EBITDA with stable take-rate quality.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Country and merchant mix compress take rate despite impressive volume.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Volatile emerging-market fintech setup; reliable current public event-implied move was unavailable.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Reliable current public revision detail was limited.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Customer and earnings momentum favor upside, but the reaction depends on whether credit expansion preserves risk-adjusted NIM and provisioning quality.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is roughly $0.22 EPS; Q2 revenue was nearly $5.9B, net income $1.1B and risk-adjusted NIM 12.4%.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Loan growth and customer monetization remain strong while cost of credit stays contained.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Provisioning or early delinquencies rise enough to reverse the NIM improvement.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: A de-risked share price supports relief, but the premium growth bar remains material.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Current previews expect continued loan and customer growth; some forecasts call for broadly stable risk-adjusted returns.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Higher Japanese rates and a strong recent beat record favor modest upside if net interest income and capital returns improve without trading weakness.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: ADR consensus is about $0.21 EPS; Mizuho has beaten the last four reported estimates and targets ¥1.3T FY2026 profit.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Rate leverage lifts NII and management raises profit or capital-return expectations.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Market revenue, credit costs or a fully priced rate benefit limit upside.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: ADR liquidity and overnight Japan price discovery can mute the U.S. event reaction.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Recent public data show a strong beat history; the stock had also suffered a sharp one-month decline.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Persistent volume weakness and cost pressure favor downside, but the depressed stock and low bar create meaningful relief-rally risk.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is about $0.15 EPS and $1.2B revenue, implying roughly 35% EPS and 3% sales declines.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Nature's Own, Simple Mills, pricing and cost savings stabilize volume and margin.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Weak demand, labor and freight costs or another guide cut extend the decline.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Indicative options were extremely wide and may overstate the pure event move; the stock is already heavily de-risked.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Consensus was stable recently, but management cut full-year sales and EBITDA ranges in Q2.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: AI momentum is real, but strong expectations and mix pressure leave limited upside unless orders broaden and FY27 guidance rises.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is about $1.32 EPS and $18.1B revenue, within management's Q1 ranges; FY27 guidance is $72.2B-$73.4B revenue.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: AI orders broaden beyond hyperscalers and full-year revenue or EPS guidance increases.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: AI mix compresses gross margin or management merely reiterates a demanding bar.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: The stock is down sharply over one month, reducing but not removing expectation risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Morgan Stanley downgraded to Equal Weight, citing strong expectations and AI gross-margin pressure.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Rapid credit growth is being accompanied by worsening delinquencies and provisions, making credit quality the likely negative override despite low valuation.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Q2 gross profit margin improved sequentially, but provisions rose 128% YoY and both 15-90 and 90+ day NPL ratios worsened.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Credit losses stabilize, gross profit inflects and buybacks magnify EPS relief.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: NPLs and provisions keep rising while management's earnings outlook trails consensus.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: The stock is deeply de-risked, so a less-bad credit print could squeeze sharply.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: A public preview noted Street 2026 EPS above the company's implied outlook.

ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Huge backlog; squeeze on guide raise
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Q3 revenue is already tightly guided, so a volatile AI tape makes 2027 capacity, customer concentration and cash intensity more likely to drive a downside reaction.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Management guided core Q3 revenue to roughly $214M-$216M; cloud growth is strong but hardware sales fell in Q2.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Management validates a steep 2027 ramp, capacity additions and backlog conversion.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Near-flat sequential revenue, cash intensity or customer concentration dominate the narrative.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Narrative AI positioning is highly unstable after the sector unwind; squeeze risk is very high.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Current previews emphasize OpenAI deployment and cloud demand, leaving a demanding forward bar.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Commercial launch proof remains thin relative to valuation, but recent de-risking and strong clinical news make a bearish earnings call low conviction.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is about -$1.52 EPS and $61M revenue; the stock fell sharply into the event.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: REDEMPLO prescriptions, payer coverage and pipeline timing beat a reset bar.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Launch uptake disappoints or cash burn overwhelms clinical progress.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options suggested roughly an 8% move; elevated short interest and a large prior decline raise squeeze risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Several analysts remain positive on pipeline value, while near-term estimates have moved lower.
